segments.he: וְשֶׁתְּהֵא אִשָּׁה מַשְׁכֶּמֶת וְאוֹפָה – כְּדֵי שֶׁתְּהֵא פַּת מְצוּיָה לַעֲנִיִּים.
segments.en: The next ordinance is: «And that a woman should rise early and bake» bread on those days when she bakes. This Gemara explains that this was instituted «so that bread should be available for poor people,» who go begging for bread in the mornings.
